items.difficulty_reason: Verify the hypotheses of lemma-flat-geometrically-connected-fibres-with-section for a smooth projective curve with a k-rational point: having a k-rational point is exactly a section of f : X -> Spec(k); H^0(X, O_X) is a field extension k' of k (varieties-lemma-regular-functions-proper-variety) and the rational point gives a k-algebra map k' -> k, forcing k' = k; then O_T -> f_{T,*}O_{X_T} is an isomorphism for all T by cohomology and base change (coherent-lemma-flat-base-change-cohomology), since every morphism to a field is flat.
